steps: Actual GUI planning, build and Godot execution produce five accepted entries and ten executed commands. The review groups the first binding as entries 1/3/4/5 with eight later same-binding receipts and the second binding as entry 2 with two; all initial cutoffs are zero. Next/previous/select preserve two distinct final idle entries without attributing the command receipts to a selected entry.

A pinned controller review stays selected while the flat-entry filter hides that controller. Chinese, English and Japanese retain the selected repeated idle entry, source buttons and eight receipt rows at 390px with no horizontal overflow.

Closing a review does not alter the recorded run. Reopening the selected controller and both review source buttons navigate to frozen binding and author-script locations through the guarded editor. Build/run, pinned review, filtering, language changes and source navigation leave every author file unchanged.
